page.overview:
Who is Deirdrik Greyspine?

is the Dwarven ambassador to the Tal'Dorei Council from the city-state of Kraghammer in 836 PD.

Although 70 years old (in 836 PD), Deirdrik is considered young for a dwarf. He is ambitious and something of a romantic idealist, generally supporting progressive ideas and policies without always thinking through the potential consequences of his actions.

As the youngest son of House Greyspine, and therefore virtually assured never to inherit a ruling position there, Deirdrik opted to pursue political success outside his home town of Kraghammer. He now serves as an ambassador with voting power on the Tal'Dorei Council, representing the interests of the sovereign city-state of Kraghammer there.

Rumors have begun circulating within Kraghammer that negotiations may be underway to have Kraghammer join the Republic of Tal'Dorei as a constituent city-state.
